item.title: Linking vegetation structure, biodiversity, and phytoindication scores to spatial patterns of ecological regimes in an urban park

item.title: Distinctive features of phytocenotic successions in mining-industrial landscapes
item.description: This study investigates ecological succession within quarry-stockpile complexes across the mining landscapes. Post-extraction use of quarries is often limited due to high restoration costs, technical challenges, and perceived impracticality. However, such sites can become valuable ecological assets, showcasing region-specific zonal flora. item.title: Influence of new growth regulators based on triazoles on winter period ontogenesis of modern wheat varieities
item.description: Triazole derivatives are valuable tools in modern agriculture, regulating diverse plant processes. In wheat, they balance growth and reproduction, bolster tolerance to abiotic and biotic stress, and unlock stable, high yields. item.title: Agro-ecological forecasting of rapeseed (Brassica napus) suitability in Ukraine under climate change scenarios
item.description: Climate change poses increasing challenges to agricultural sustainability, particularly for crops such as rapeseed that are sensitive to thermal and hydrological conditions.
